scope: Research design; this file does not authorize paid execution or claim preparation complete

target.success_claim: Report both seeds separately; two-seed-average target requires their test-score mean >=47.2115. Never select deployment seed on test.

evaluation.metric: Sum TP/FP/FN across all valid original-image pixels per class, then macro-average the four class IoUs; no background
evaluation.dtype: cast logits to float32 before sigmoid; align probabilities to original image then fuse in float32; strict threshold; integer counts

seed2024.procedure: Run exact archived F12 configuration and existing seed2024 F stream for 12000 updates, fixed endpoint, no node selection

initialization.within_seed: C,S,D,SD share exact parent model state; fresh optimizer for all; no parent optimizer resume
initialization.independence_limit: Two Q training lineages; common pretraining, P0 and dataset; not independent test datasets

spatial_interaction.architecture: ViT-Adapter-inspired early injection; custom adaptation, not DINOv3 official dense recipe reproduction
spatial_interaction.extract_keys: current ViT patch token grid, stride16
spatial_interaction.zero_initialize: each injector output projection and each domain-specific spatial-to-DPT final projection; no serial zero gates
spatial_interaction.gradient_gate: zero projections nonzero finite grad at first update; upstream spatial modules nonzero finite grad after first update

external_data.name: TJDR
requirements: verify dataset terms separately from repository code license
verify actual label values/palette and image-mask pairing
verify four-class annotation completeness including negatives
exact and near-duplicate isolation versus DDR train/val/test image identities
patient grouping if identifiers exist; state uncertainty otherwise
exclude external images duplicating DDR val/test
external_data.geometry: native pixels,1024 window,768 supervised center,128 halo; no forced whole-image resize
external_data.sampler: 4 windows/update:2 foreground with class cycling+2 uniform; select one of the two camera sources with equal probability then image uniformly; deterministic fallback recorded in stream
external_data.decoder: independent copy of parent DDR decoder/RGB; SD new spatial-to-decoder projections are domain-specific; shared backbone/spatial stream; discard TJDR decoder for DDR inference
external_data.negative_transfer_limit: separate decoder does not prevent shared-backbone negative transfer
external_data.failure_behavior: Do not start D/SD. C/S-only is a separately declared reduced experiment, not completion of this campaign. No processed classification-pool substitution.

training.DDR_sampler: 4 foreground +4 uniform; inherited augmentation/geometry; identical saved stream across arms of each seed
training.precision: bfloat16 forward; float32 masked BCE/Dice and output probabilities
training.loss_micro: Existing Q masked loss:0.5*BCE+0.5*Dice; reduction axes batch/spatial then class mean among valid classes; ignore/padding excluded
training.loss_update: mean(4 DDR micro-losses)+0.25*mean(2 TJDR micro-losses) when source active; otherwise DDR mean only
training.rng: separate module-init/source/data streams; additional source passes must not perturb paired DDR data,augmentation,or existing-backbone stochastic stream

validation_and_selection.scientific_primary_output: EMA single model; fixed25percent fusion as system comparison; no cross-formula subtraction
validation_and_selection.candidate_identity: same arm,update,formula for both seeds; completed two-seed recipes only
validation_and_selection.rank: First retain candidates satisfying test_gate; then descending mean of two seed validation mIoUs within eligible set; freeze highest-ranked eligible candidate; empty set means retain R and no new test
validation_and_selection.tie: exact unrounded equality; single before fusion,20000 before32000,C/S/D/SD,25percent before50percent
validation_and_selection.test_gate: Both seed gains vs corresponding R strictly positive and mean gain >=0.5pp
validation_and_selection.gate_meaning: resource/deployment threshold, not statistical significance or target achievement
validation_and_selection.final_test: Freeze/hash recipe,formula,weights,data and inference; evaluate both seeds once; do not change selection afterwards
forbidden: seed probability ensemble added after results
validation_and_selection.if_none_qualifies: retain R and report all completed outcomes; do not test to search for a winner

resources.scientific_interpretation: two-factor engineering-package comparison at fixed DDR exposure; not isolated pure data causality
resources.GPU: one user-assigned 24GB GPU, serial; no contact with other experiment server
resources.before_cost_quote: benchmark100 complete backward+optimizer updates for each distinct execution path and full validation timing; include source compute,I/O and checkpoint cost

stop_and_archive.curve_review_trigger: at two consecutive formal val nodes, single >3pp below parent and 25percent pipeline >1.5pp below R; review before cancelling, no blind restart
archive: final selected test counts if qualified
stop_and_archive.shutdown: Only after complete verified local recovery under user's execution authorization; verify platform state, not merely SSH disconnect
